brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pledged to advance two bills targeting NAZA filmmakers, vowing to revoke their citizenship and address what he characterized as "immense damage" done to Israeli soldiers, Al Jazeera English reported. The move signals a hardening stance against documentary producers whose work has drawn criticism from Israeli officials.

Details of the specific legislation and the filmmakers' identities were not immediately available. Netanyahu's threat comes as Israel faces international scrutiny over military operations and documentation of combat activities.
dek: Israeli prime minister pledges to advance two bills aimed at addressing the 'immense damage' done to Israeli soldiers.
title: Netanyahu threatens to revoke citizenship of NAZA filmmakers
